plugins.name: super-ralph
plugins.description: Design-first autonomous development workflow. /design produces implementation-ready epics with [STORY]/[BE]/[FE]/[INT] sub-issues. v0.11.0 adds --local mode (write entire plan to a single markdown file, skip GitHub) and /improve-design (single-prompt adjustments to existing designs). Fire-and-forget build → review → verify → release pipelines. Domain-aware repair with hotfix flow.

plugins.name: forth-ai-harness
plugins.description: Technical-cofounder-in-a-plugin for ForthAI Work. Thirteen slash commands take a rough idea from discovery to a merged, deployed, polished product: /finit /fbrainstorm /fspec /fdesign /fbuild /fpolish /ftest /ffix /flaunch /fautopilot /fretro /fdream /fhelp. Three lifecycles (Build/Fix/Hotfix) auto-routed from /goal; every PR passes a mandatory Codex review gate (0 P0+P1+APPROVE). /fautopilot is an AIPA autopilot run-loop with an engine-evaluated READ→DRY_RUN→COMMIT two-phase-write gate (human approval non-bypassable). Four on-demand domain packs (AIPA, enterprise-integration ERP/CRM connectors, comms-platforms WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack/WeChat-Work/Lark, finance intl+China) plug in with zero always-loaded cost. Optional Claude+Codex dual-AI via --codex; Claude-only mode supported. GitHub is SSoT (Milestones + Issues); artifacts are AI-readable markdown.
